description: Converts a Tripo 3D mesh to GLTF, USDZ, FBX, OBJ, STL, or 3MF (Tripo Conversion).

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

animate_in_place.description: Animate in place (default false; dropped on wire if false).

bake.description: Bake (default false; dropped on wire if false).

export_orientation.description: Export orientation (default 'default'; dropped on wire when 'default').

export_vertex_colors.description: Export vertex colors (default false; dropped on wire if false).

face_limit.description: Face limit (-1 means 'no limit'; dropped on wire when -1).

fbx_preset.description: FBX preset (default blender; dropped on wire when blender).

flatten_bottom.description: Flatten bottom (default false; dropped on wire if false).

flatten_bottom_threshold.description: Flatten bottom threshold (default 0.0; dropped on wire when 0.0).

force_symmetry.description: Force symmetry (default false; dropped on wire if false).

format.description: Target format (GLTF, USDZ, FBX, OBJ, STL, 3MF).

original_model_task_id.description: The task_id of the model to convert (MODEL_TASK_ID, RIG_TASK_ID, or RETARGET_TASK_ID).

pack_uv.description: Pack UVs (default false; dropped on wire if false).

part_names.description: Comma-separated part names (default empty). Split on `,` and trimmed at body-assembly time per node.py:848-851.

pivot_to_center_bottom.description: Pivot to center bottom (default false; dropped on wire if false).

quad.description: Apply quad mesh (default false; dropped on wire if false).

scale_factor.description: Scale factor (default 1.0; dropped on wire when 1.0).

texture_format.description: Texture format (default JPEG; dropped on wire when JPEG).

texture_size.description: Texture size (default 4096; dropped on wire when 4096).

with_animation.description: Include animations (default false; dropped on wire if false).
